recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future temporary-location semantics or V2 mapping changes should be handled as new PA work rather than reopening FHIR-8120.
issue_request: FHIR-8120 was Published with resolution Persuasive. It questioned the ambiguity of the original present status when multiple Encounter.location entries could exist and approved changing Encounter location status to Planned, Active, Reserved, and Completed.
initial_application: Commit bf320e3425c2ad24825390bfd7c87d565b89b39b, titled Tracker# 8120, Encounter location status, changed the historical Encounter spreadsheet from planned | present | reserved to planned | active | reserved | completed, renamed present to active, added completed, and added guidance about completing a location after the patient is no longer active there.
additional_context: FHIR-3846 originally added the same element. The current build uses source/encounter because encounter=Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-12321 later cleaned carriage-return artifacts in the same definitions and is already represented on the combined branch. Later temporary-location and V2 PL-5 mapping discussions did not record a core reversal of the FHIR-8120 code set.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/encounter/codesystem-encounter-location-status.xml defines exactly planned, active, reserved, and completed, and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml binds Encounter.location.status required to that value set.
